title: WsSession: no close() method; must drop to send Close frame
description: WsSession exposes next_frame and send_request but no close() method. Callers who want to gracefully close the connection must drop the WsSession, which sends a tungstenite Close frame on drop. This is not discoverable — a caller who wants to send a Close frame before dropping (e.g. in a reconnect loop) has no API surface for it. Could mislead callers into not realizing the connection is properly closed on drop.
